name: happy-path-crud
description: Simple CRUD API with one Create scenario, no async callbacks, no state machine. Smallest valid plan the skill should produce.

fixture.service_shape: single REST endpoint POST /resources accepting JSON, persists to one table, returns 201 with created row

required_lines: | # | Scenario | Status | HTTP | Outcome | Traces | Logs |

name: async-callback
description: Endpoint that POSTs/PUTs back to a customer-supplied response URL (CFN-style). Plan must spawn the catch-all listener.

fixture.service_shape: endpoint accepts SNS-wrapped CFN custom resource event with a ResponseURL field; service later PUTs to that URL

name: state-machine-with-timeout
description: Feature with multiple lifecycle states + watchdog timeout. Must exercise each transition + the timeout-fired path.

fixture.service_shape: resource has inProgress -> verifying -> completed/error states; watchdog Temporal workflow fires after configurable timeout

name: input-validation-rejection
description: At least one scenario must be a 4xx-expected case. Plan must use the explicit status+body capture pattern (not curl -i | head -1).

fixture.service_shape: any service with a request validator

name: reset-safe-rerun
description: Service enforces a uniqueness constraint on a tuple test scenarios reuse. Plan must include state-reset SQL so the SECOND run of the plan doesn't fail on a leftover row.

fixture.service_shape: service has a unique index on (account_id, resource_kind); test scenarios all use the same fixture account
